Subject: Call for volunteers

Dear IIMS Postgrad students

I'm now calling for volunteers to serve on the IIMS postgraduate  
student committee.

The main purpose of this committee will be to organize the IIMS P/G  
conference that is normally held near the end of October each year.  
Also, the IIMS P/G will organize other events such as IIMS  
postgraduate seminars held from time-to-time.

This is a chance to be pro-actively involved in the post-graduate  
affairs and culture within IIMS. This would suit mainly current  
Masters or PhD students in their first and second years, but  
volunteers from all walks of life will be welcome.

If any of you would like to do this, please let me know.

Cheers, Ian

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Ian Bond, IIMS P/G Coordinator
Institute for Information and Mathematical Sciences
Massey University
+64-9-414-0800 ext 9430
r.g.brsh@massey.ac.nz
